notes: Keep the recorded dissent distinct from institutional decisions and collective unanimity.
Distinguish procedural validity, practical effect and normative justification. A constitutional vote does not create basic rights from nothing.
Distinguish a binding judgment not executed from a seven-judge view falling short of an eight-vote threshold. Do not call the latter an operative invalidation.
Keep pre-service refusal, existing proceedings and desertion distinct; acquired-citizenship fraud is not later dissent. Statelessness does not justify indefinite suspension.
Separate military command from independent confirmation; war-dependent authority ends with the defensive necessity, not merely a later formal announcement.
Keep the sanctions' demonstrated mechanisms separate from unverified total causal attribution. A diplomatic reply is not itself a personally usable complaint channel.

Keep military necessity distinct from individual harm; prisoners and non-fighting wounded combatants are not treated as active targets. Occupation does not confer control over another population's direction.
Do not turn postwar accountability into retrospective invention of an offence or automatic blame for everyone on a council. A temporary hearing is not a standing remedy.
